description: 📌Checkmyguest offers you this magnificent 79 m² apartment in the lively Clignancourt neighborhood. This accommodation offers a comfortable and elegant living space. Its prime location makes it easy to discover Paris' iconic monuments, including the Sacré-Cœur Basilica in Montmartre.The space⭐ Located in a beautiful Parisian building, this 79 m² luxury apartment welcomes you in a spacious, modern, and chic setting in the heart of the lively Clignancourt neighborhood in Paris's 18th arrondissement. Designed to combine elegance and comfort, it can accommodate up to 8 people and is the ideal place to stay with family or friends.📍 Ideally located on Rue de Clignancourt, in the dynamic Clignancourt neighborhood, you will enjoy an authentic and lively atmosphere, renowned for its picturesque markets, charming cobbled streets, and typical Parisian ambiance. Close to public transportation, you can easily reach the capital's iconic sites while enjoying neighborhood life, with local shops, friendly cafés, and gourmet restaurants.The interior, minimalist with light notes, reveals : ✔️ A living area, featuring a comfortable sofa bed for relaxing with family or friends, ideal for resting after a day of Parisian discoveries.✔️ A spacious dining area, fitted out to comfortably accommodate your group meals and offering a warm, friendly atmosphere.✔️ A functional, fully-equipped kitchen, open to the living area, including fridge, freezer, oven, microwave, hob, coffee machine, toaster and kettle, perfect for preparing delicious meals.✔️ Three elegant and spacious bedrooms, each equipped with a comfortable double bed and bespoke closets, offering optimal storage space and a restful setting for peaceful nights.✔️ Two modern bathrooms with showers and washbasins. A WC in one of the bathrooms
